invariants.rationale: Spacing values such as icon spacing are conventionally expected to be non-negative.
Spacing values such as icon spacing are conventionally expected to be non-negative.
It is common for left and right spacing to be equal; this could be an invariant in some usages.
Alternatively, the method allows for asymmetric spacing; this invariant distinguishes the case where spacings differ.
Even if individual spacings could be negative, their total spacing is likely expected to be non-negative to avoid illegal layout states.
